hook.name: LaunchHook
hook.description: Singleton Uniswap v4 hook for all pools created by LaunchFactory. Takes trading fees on the stock side (currency0) of each pair—on input for exact-input buys, on output for all other cases—and splits each fee among a platform treasury (30%), a pool creator, and token holders via a FeeDistributor. Exact-output sells are not supported and will revert.
